title: Prefixes anti-, mid-, under- · Roots aud, graph/gram, ject, mit/mis · The Internet: How a Message Travels
goal: Read, spell, and use words with *anti-, mid-, under-*; learn four more commonly-useful roots; apply both to a passage on how a message actually travels across the internet.
review: *scrib/script, tract, rupt, vis/vid* — one example word each.
time: 30–45 min — content-dense, fine to run slightly long. **Materials:** paper, pencil, timer.
